verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe self-hosting the complete Flagsmith platform on own infrastructure with full control over data, security, and deployment, plus a documented Docker-based setup guide and an Edge Proxy for running the engine within own infra. This directly matches the story of an OSS self-hosted distribution keeping evaluation data on the platform engineer's own infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a production self-hosted deployment beyond docs/Docker quickstart.
